terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.summary: Cloudive provides open, free educational blueprints and curriculum packs for individual self-study and university instruction. No commercial resale or scraping.

refunds.title: Voluntary Support & Contribution Policy
refunds.summary: All Cloudive core curriculum packs, foundation workbooks, and roadmaps are 100% free to download. Financial support is voluntary. We do not sell subscriptions.

license.title: Open Educational Terms & License
license.summary: Cloudive curriculum is provided freely for personal, individual, and classroom educational use under open terms with standard non-commercial resale restrictions.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement (WCAG 2.1 AA)
accessibility.summary: Cloudive is committed to digital accessibility, maintaining WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with high-contrast text ratios, keyboard navigation, and semantic HTML.
